描述_EN: many grave goods were models of domestic animals but occasionally a beast from the mythical world would be given shape, such as this creature with a conjoint body and two heads. in the northern wei dynasty (420-589) objects for burial were made of earthenware.
描述_ZN: 许多墓葬品都是家畜的模型，但偶尔也会有神话中的野兽被塑造出来，比如这个有两个头的联合体的生物。 在北魏时期（420-589），随葬品是用陶器制作的。
